text: For a long time, I couldn't think of my husband without seeing him drowning. The peaceful memories of him were replaced by that image. I couldn't look at the sea. I had nightmares about the grey faces. My grief was much heavier and more complicated than it would have been. My relationship with my daughter suffered because she blamed me and my friend.

Ich hatte danach große Angst vor Menschenmengen. Ich bin seitdem auf kein Konzert mehr gegangen. Auch im Supermarkt, in der Bahn oder in vollen Straßen bekam ich Panikattacken, vor allem wenn ich mich eingeengt gefühlt habe. Das Bild der gestürzten Frau kam immer wieder. Mittlerweile kann ich wieder Bahn fahren, aber nicht zur Rushhour.
Learned a lot about myself actually, and about the relationship.

For about a year I was terrified of being possessed again. Every time I felt a strong emotion, especially anger, I worried it was the demon. I couldn't sleep alone. I had nightmares of the face in the mirror. I avoided mirrors in dark rooms. I had intrusive thoughts of being dragged to hell.

My relationship with my parents became confusing. They kept telling the story of my 'deliverance' at church and asking me to give testimony, which I refused. I felt like I was living a lie, because I knew deep down it was the drug, but I couldn't shake the fear that they were right.

I developed a depression, mostly from the shame and confusion. I lost touch with the friends who were there that night.

The scars on my arms are still visible.
Ich hatte einige Monate lang Kopfschmerzen und Schwindel und hatte Angst vor Treppen. Ich habe seitdem keine Drogen mehr genommen.
I was scared for a couple of weeks that I'd damaged my brain, because I had memory gaps. That faded. Now I'm just very angry at the company.

For years I had anxiety about being judged or caught. I became very obedient and rule-following. I had nightmares about the hospital and the doctors. I felt like everyone at school saw me as a druggie, and I was quite isolated for the rest of that school year. I felt deep shame for disappointing my parents and I think that turned into a mild depression. I couldn't travel abroad for a long time without getting anxious. I'm 24 now and I still get a sick feeling when I see a teacher scolding a child.

Die Wochen nach dem Tod meines Hundes waren die schlimmsten meines Lebens. Ich hatte ständig das Bild von ihm auf der Straße vor Augen, das Blut an meinen Händen. Ich hatte Albträume, in denen ich durch einen dunklen Wald laufe und ihn rufe. Ich konnte nicht mehr in den Wald gehen. Ich habe mich wahnsinnig schuldig gefühlt und war überzeugt, dass ich ihn getötet habe. Zusammen mit der Trennung hat das eine schwere Depression ausgelöst. Ich hatte Suizidgedanken und konnte monatelang nicht arbeiten.

I developed panic disorder after that night. At first the panic attacks came almost daily, mostly triggered by my heartbeat, if I noticed it beating fast, or skipping, I'd go into full panic, convinced I was dying. I went to the ER four times in the first two months. Every test was normal. I started avoiding exercise, coffee, sex, anything that made my heart rate go up. I stopped going to the gym, which I'd loved.

I also had a lot of derealisation, especially during and after panic attacks. The world would go flat and far away. That scared me even more because I thought I was going crazy.

I became quite depressed in the second half of the year because my life had shrunk so much. I couldn't travel, couldn't go to concerts, could barely go to work.

I've had panic attacks before in my life, but never like this.

I felt enormous guilt for a long time. My brother was okay after a few days, thankfully, but I couldn't forgive myself. My mum and I didn't speak properly for months. I had nightmares about his screaming.

Seitdem sehe ich ständig Nachbilder und ein leichtes Flimmern, vor allem bei wenig Licht. Am Anfang hatte ich deswegen große Angst und dachte, mein Gehirn ist kaputt. Ich hatte auch einige Monate lang Derealisation und konnte mich schlecht konzentrieren. Die Angst ist inzwischen weniger, aber die visuellen Störungen sind nach drei Jahren immer noch da. Manchmal frage ich mich, ob ich jemals wieder 'normal' sehen werde.
Felt really stupid for a while. Didn't date for a few months. Some anxiety.
